purpose: Retrospective comparative-validity correction, not new confirmation
problems: All 40 frozen evaluation problems; four separate frozen development problems for validation
inputs: Saved k=0,1,2 omission closures and unchanged nominal paid stopping histories; no case regeneration
tie_scope: B cost_order and C constant_first at the existing 50% anchor; replace only last opaque-ID tie with same problem/trial ranking in both arms
tie_invariants: Preserve constant priority, costs, unaffordable-next-action cutoff, paid outcomes, and first-conflict stopping
stop: Before next acquisition, stop iff every complete fixed-k=2 design signature compatible with paid history is nominally possible; first observed contradiction always stops
not_a_stop: Zero immediate contradiction scores do not authorize STOP while a nonnominal compatible complete signature remains
unchanged_choices: Otherwise delegate to the unchanged D or D_affordable selector, including their opaque-ID ties and historical affordability semantics
budget: floor(anchor_percent * original residual catalogue cost / 100); no second allowance
charging: Retain paid nominal acquisition separately; charge added retrieval on all signatures, including nominal-compatible ones
comparator_E: Reuse saved exact-frontier anchor paths/results; never solve a new policy
aggregation: Raw counts and costs across original, new, and all signatures; per-problem and stratum tables; all 200 tie results and ranges. k=1 and k=2 reuse signatures and are not independent repetitions
information: Selectors receive nominal model, paid history, declared hypothetical envelope if authorized, and budget only for affordability-aware selector. Never actual k, realized omissions, unpaid answers, or full-archive evaluator labels
interpretation: Finite supplied-hypothesis instance optimization and tie sensitivity, not held-out model generalization, deployment benefit, incident sampling inference, or claim-support improvement
preservation: Original implementation, result and protocol files remain unchanged; new source/test/protocol and exact computational inputs hash-frozen before new diagnostic evaluation
validation: Four development problems and tiny complementarity fixtures; unchanged replay parity against saved historical anchor paths before diagnostic choices
